name: Facebook
verifiedWith: Facebook 582.0 on Android 17 (emulator, English UI); Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 on Android 16 (Sharp SH-M35, Traditional Chinese UI)
notes: Facebook exposes almost no view IDs. The selected Reels tab is labelled 'Reels, tab 2 of 6'. A Reel opened from the news feed is full screen without a tab bar: it is one big element (about 88% of the screen height) whose description starts with 'Reel'. A Reel playing inside the feed is smaller (about 58%) and is deliberately not matched. Caption and hashtags are readable.
